subject: Draft: Evaluation plan + close roadmap for Acme PoC
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire@acme.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft evaluation plan + initial timeline (see linked doc)

Hi Claire,

Great talking earlier — thanks for walking through Acme's top success metrics. As discussed, I pulled together a short starter pack to make the PoC evaluation and decision timeline explicit so we can align stakeholders and remove blockers.

What's in the Google Doc:
- Mutual action plan (owner, deliverable, due date)
- Evaluation checklist mapped to your three KPIs (latency, throughput, quality)
- Recommended internal cadences (weekly sync, executive checkpoint)

Please take a look at the draft here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFgAcme-MAP-template (editable by your team). I included two proposed close timelines depending on procurement speed:
- Fast path: 6 weeks (exec signed by Mar 20)
- Standard: 10 weeks (exec signed by Apr 15)

Next steps I suggest:
1) You and Bob add any missing evaluation criteria to the doc by EOD Thu 2/12.
2) We schedule a 60-min evaluation kickoff workshop next week to walk the checklist and test plan (I can coordinate).

Attachments: acme_map_template_v1.gdoc (link), evaluation_checklist.xlsx (stub)

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
https://www.redwood.ai
From: Claire Nguyen <claire@acme.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bob Turner <bob.turner@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft evaluation plan + initial timeline (see linked doc)

Thanks Monica — this is helpful and appreciated. A few quick notes after a skim:
- I added two stakeholders to the doc: Engineering lead (Sara Lim) and Procurement (Jamal Khan). They need visibility but we won't loop them into every meeting.
- On KPIs: please add a required sample size for quality evaluation (we typically want ~1,000 sessions over a week for statistically meaningful feedback).
- Procurement will likely push us toward the Standard timeline unless legal can speed review.

Can we do the kickoff on Thurs 2/12 at 10am PT? I think Bob, Sara, and I can attend.

Claire
VP Product, Acme AI
claire@acme.ai | +1 212-555-0199

Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft evaluation plan + initial timeline (see linked doc)

Claire / team — quick procurement note from my side:
- Acme's procurement usually requires a security review + standard DPA redlines. For a mid-market deal we can aim for a 2-week legal review if Acme runs our standard DPA and doesn't submit heavy redlines.
- If Jamal (Procurement) wants a PO-first workflow, we should align on the SLA tiers now (we recommended Dedicated for sustained throughput, but Hosted could be fine for the PoC).

For timeline planning: if procurement needs to be involved early, the realistic close date is Apr 15. If procurement is happy to sign after a successful PoC demo, we can push the fast path.

I'll add a short procurement checklist to the MAP doc.

— Aditya
Principal Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire@acme.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft evaluation plan + initial timeline (see linked doc)

Adding the evaluation checklist (attached) and some test-case examples:
- Throughput: 10k QPS sustained for 10 minutes using synthetic load (owner: Eng - Sara Lim)
- Latency: p95 < 120ms for 512-token responses (owner: Redwood runtime team)
- Quality: human-rated accuracy on 1,000 sessions (owner: Product - Claire)

Attachment: evaluation_checklist.xlsx [Attachment stub]

On the kickoff logistics: Thurs 2/12 10am PT works for us. I'll bring the test harness plan and can demo a live prefix-caching flow.

Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | (510) 555-0148

Cc: Claire Nguyen <claire@acme.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft evaluation plan + initial timeline (see linked doc)

Team / Claire — quick alignment from my side:
- The MAP looks good. Recommend we lock the executive checkpoint dates in the doc so Acme has visibility to the sign-off milestone.
- For sales forecasting: please set expected close probability to 60% on the Standard path, 35% on Fast path. We can revise after the kickoff and first-week test results.
- If procurement drags, we should be prepared to offer a 3-month pilot pricing credit (no SLA) to keep momentum. Aditya, happy to discuss discount guardrails offline.

Claire — thanks for adding stakeholders. Monica, can you update the doc with the executive checkpoint dates and ping Jamal (Procurement) to confirm review window? I'll join the kickoff if timing allows.

Markus Klein
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
